reproducibility.inputs: current pipeline measurements of the triggering location for units built up to the trigger
reproducibility.note: Re-running the method with the same params and inputs reproduces the ranking (the permutation test is seeded).

location.name: Front door to front fender, mid
location.description: Gap between LH front door leading edge and front fender, at belt-line height.

limitations: 6 units were excluded because their route is incomplete (production events rejected during import).
No statistically significant sustained mean shift was found before the trigger; the deviation may be an isolated event. Contributor ranking was not performed.

provenance.statement: Simulated production history and procedurally generated, calibrated inspection images. Not real factory data; no affiliation with any manufacturer.
